labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks whether a pull request may be opened; Contribution process, so routed to the question label.

items.body:
Please describe the link fix in an issue before opening a pull request. Under the project's policy, a change is proposed in an issue first. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the process, and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) if you use AI tools. Related policy discussions: #4203 and #4029.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
